{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.22

|branch= dev

|arg= local

|eff= local

|gr1= Vehicle Loadouts

|descr= Executes an action on a specific pylon. MP effect and locality depend on the specific action.<br><br>
Components and their actions:<br>
CameraComponent
* SetLightState (arg bool, ret none)
* GetLightState (arg none, ret bool)
<br>
TransportPylonsComponent (pylon index -1, no component name, no component index)<br>
* GetLastFiredPylonIndex (no arg, ret scalar), returns the pylon index (note this is script index, which is 1-based) that last fired the gun, or -1 if the last firing was not from a pylon (can be used in Fired eventhandler)

<br>
All pylons (Not on a component)<br>
* animateSource - Arg local, effect global. See [[animateSource]] pylonAction [vehicle player, 1, "animateSource", ["extendBoxSource", 1]];



|s1= [[pylonAction]] [vehicle, pylon, actionPath(, arguments)]

|p1= vehicle: [[Object]] - The object carrying the pylon

|p2= pylon: [[Number]] or [[String]] - pylon index (index starts from 1) or pylon name (see {{Link|#Example 1}}). Or -1 to access the TransportPylonsComponent of the vehicle

|p3= actionPath: [[String]] - The path to reach the specific component to send the action to.<br>
actionPath is a "." delimited address of the component and action (like animation sources). Or (without a "." a command to the pylon directly)<br>
arguments and return type depends on the final action<br>
ActionPath examples<br>
"CameraComponent.0.SetLightState" with argument bool, returns nothing.<br>
"CameraComponent.0.GetLightState" with no argument, returns bool.<br>
"CameraComponent.*.SetLightState" wildcard executes the action all components of that type (if there are multiple). Note the return value will be the value of the last executed action

|p4= 

|p5= 

|r1= [[Anything]] - Depends on action

|seealso= [[Arma_3:_Vehicle_Loadouts]] {{Link|https://community.bistudio.com/wiki/Category:Maintenance/RV/See_also_needed|See also needed}}
}}
